acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves local receipt validation against the declared handoff; it does not prove deployment, production behavior, customer acceptance, or outcomes.
evidenceRequired: Focused receipt-contract tests pass for valid and tampered receipts.
A repository-bound receipt audit records exact handoff, task, commit, ownership, validation, and evidence equivalence.

completionCriteria: The AgentFlow receipt schema is fully enforced before any execution or integration claim is emitted.
Receipt base commit equals the approved handoff base commit and receipt task IDs exactly equal the approved handoff task IDs.
Every integrated task has valid result and integration commits, changed files within its declared ownership, and passing required validations.
Every required evidence class from the handoff is present and digest-verifiable in the receipt.
Missing tasks, extra tasks, ownership escapes, failed or empty required validations, inconsistent commits, incomplete evidence, and stale handoffs fail closed.
The audit claim distinguishes local execution and integration from deployment, provider behavior, production readiness, customer acceptance, and outcomes.
nonObjectives: Do not move execution into Proofloom.
Do not infer deployment, production, provider, customer, or business outcomes from a build receipt.
Do not relax task ownership or validation equivalence to accept a receipt.
objective: Strengthen Proofloom's AgentFlow receipt audit until its local execution and integration claim is fully evidence-bound.
title: Make AgentFlow receipt claims evidence-complete
